Prepare expected catch matrix

Source: R/check_exp.R
check_exp.Rd

Checks that specified expected catch matrices exists and is formatted correctly when make_model_design is called.

Usage

check_exp(ec, ec_names)

Arguments

ec

Expected catch list created by create_expectations.

ec_names

The names of the expected catch matrices to include in the model and how they are used (i.e. used together or separately). See the expectcatchmodels argument in make_model_design.

Value

Returns a list containing the filtered expected catch list and specified matrices to include in model.

Details

Checks that ec_names is specified properly by identifying invalid options such as combining 'individual' or 'all' with any other option or including matrices that don't exist in ec.
